title: Replace With The Lesson Title
objective: One or two sentences: what should the learner understand or be able to do after this lesson?
studentQuestion: The single question a student hears that frames this lesson.
newIdea: What is genuinely new here that was not true in a prior lesson? Leave this field out entirely for a pure Fluency lesson.

teaching.setup: How the problem/material is first presented, before any reasoning begins.
teaching.see: What the learner is asked to notice.
teaching.build: What is done with the decomposed pieces.
teaching.transform: What stays the same and what changes — this is where Same Value, Different Form is made explicit, in whatever form fits THIS lesson (it does not have to be an algebraic-looking step).

check.prompt: How the answer is verified — must be a strategy from src/curriculum/constants.js CHECK_STRATEGIES.

examples.second: A second worked example, same structure, different numbers.
examples.transfer: An example not explicitly modeled, used to check independent transfer.

mastery.evidence: The smallest useful evidence that the learner has actually understood this, not just answered correctly once.
